/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch() { node -e 'let d=\"\";process.stdin.on(\"data\",c=>d+=c).on(\"end\",()=>{let s=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],\"utf8\");for(const m of d.split(/\\n(?=%%\\"'$%%)/g)){if(!m.trim())continue;let [h,...p]=m.split("'"\\n\");let act=h.slice(5);p=p.slice(0,-1);if(act===\"Add File: \"+process.argv[1]){fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[1],p.map(x=>x.slice(1)).join(\"\\n\")+\"\\n\")}else if(act===\"Update File: \"+process.argv[1]){p.forEach(x=>{let op=x[0],line=x.slice(1);if(op===\"+\")s=s.replace(line+\"\\n\",line+\"\\n\");else if(op===\"-\")s=s.replace(line+\"\\n\",\"\")})}}fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[1],s)})' \""'$1"; }; true'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"container|height|wrapper|CSS|data prop\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md | head -40; printf '\\n--- lint ---\\n'; npm exec tsc -- --noEmit"
